listing.title: Currency Converter Honest Fern
listing.fullDescription:
A quiet currency converter for Android. Convert between 34 fiat currencies and 11 cryptocurrencies, see historical charts, and pin your most-used pairs. No account, login, or first-party analytics.

CONVERT
Type an amount, choose a base currency, and see the rest at a glance. Reference exchange rates and crypto prices are fetched online. The app shows the source date.

CHARTS
View historical rate charts for supported currency pairs. Unlock extended chart access with Charts Pro.

FAVORITES
Save your most-used pairs and return to them quickly. The free version includes a starter set; Favorites Pro unlocks more pairs.

OFFLINE
Once rates have been loaded online, the app keeps the last known rates and chart data on your device. The status shows when data is cached or stale.

DARK MODE
Use a calm light or dark theme.

PRIVACY
No Honest Fern account, login, cloud sync, or first-party analytics. Favorites, settings, and cached rates stay on your device. The free version uses Google AdMob for banner and opt-in rewarded ads. One-time purchases can remove ads or unlock premium features. See the privacy policy for Google advertising data practices.

SUPPORTED DATA
34 fiat currencies and 11 cryptocurrencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, and Cardano.
